interface.name: zsingularity_pacing_manager_v1

description.summary: limit how often an output is repainted

interface.description: Lets the desktop shell cap the frame rate of an output below its refresh rate, for form factors such as a television where a steady lower rate looks the same and costs less power and heat. The compositor paints the output and sends frame callbacks to its surfaces at most at that rate, so clients slow down with it. The video mode is never changed. Limits set through a manager are removed when that manager is destroyed.

description.summary: destroy the manager and remove its limits

request.name: set_max_rate

description.summary: set the frame rate limit of an output

request.description: Sets the limit in frames per second. Zero, or a value at or above the refresh rate of the output, removes the limit.
